rationale: The «Переиспользование» finding explicitly states that formatPrice fully duplicates the existing, test-covered formatMoney in src/money.ts, itemizing the duplicated logic — sign handling, whole/fraction splitting, thousands grouping, and the currency symbol table — with per-line cross-references, satisfying the duplication criterion. It names formatMoney and src/money.ts as the reuse target, and the proposed remedy (delete src/pricing.ts and use formatMoney, or turn formatPrice into a thin re-export while updating imports) reuses the existing abstraction instead of keeping a second implementation. The finding is located at src/pricing.ts:1 with further line citations, so all four criteria hold.
